note: Each part a recipient holds this record to: present, or absent with why. It is under MANIFEST.txt, and its signature: a part taken out of the package, and out of this list, breaks it. swarm.sh verify fails on a part that is missing and not declared absent.

components.what: the custody verdict
components.reason: no custody was taken for this run (swarm.sh stop takes it)

components.what: the verdict's anchor, kept outside the run
the verdict's signature
components.reason: custody.json was not signed (--custody-sign-key)

components.what: the verdict's RFC 3161 timestamp token
components.reason: custody.json was not timestamped (--custody-timestamp-url)

components.what: the index of work/ custody sealed at stop
components.reason: no custody was taken, so nothing sealed work/

components.what: the trace
the trace's anchor
the ledger
components.reason: nothing was recorded

components.what: the ledger's attestations
components.reason: no entry has a second author

components.what: the agents' disputes of entries
components.reason: no agent disputed an entry

components.what: the store sweeps: what the hub found when it searched every output the run held for each coverage record's strings, and each evidence addition's reverse sweep of its files for the standing records' strings (a chain of its own, sealed by custody)
components.reason: no store sweep ran (no coverage record named what a hit would contain)

components.what: the finish register: the coordinator's lease, readiness, the checks and the report's reviews (unsigned, sealed by custody)
components.reason: the run has no finish register (no seat coordinated a finish, or a run from before it)

components.what: the lead register: how the investigation proceeded (unsigned, sealed by custody)
components.reason: no lead was opened

components.what: the lead register, rendered
components.reason: no lead was opened

components.what: the question register: what the examination was asked, by whom (the goal, an agent, a person, claimed or signed), and how each question stood (unsigned as a whole, sealed by custody)
the question register, rendered
what the run asked of the operator, one line per request as it stood
components.reason: nothing was asked of the operator

components.what: the operator requests' chain: every request (a lead's needs, an acquisition, a clarification, a network item, a stop proposed) with its id and lifecycle (unsigned, sealed by custody)
components.reason: nothing was asked of the operator, or the run is from before the chain

components.what: the operator requests, rendered
components.reason: nothing was asked of the operator

components.what: what entered the run after its kickoff (evidence add, material add): each addition's provenance record and manifest; the bytes stay with the evidence
components.reason: in the run, and not copied: it is not a regular file there, or it is empty

components.what: the dynamic network's requests, decisions and grants (a chain of its own, sealed by custody)
components.reason: the run made no network request

components.what: every fetch the fetch service made (a chain of its own, sealed by custody)
components.reason: the run fetched nothing

components.what: the hosts the operator allowed while the run went on
components.reason: the operator allowed no host during the run

components.what: the store's journal
the model gateway's call log (a chain of its own, sealed by custody by its lines and their sha256)
components.reason: the run had no model gateway (a host run)

components.what: the journal's anchor
the examiner's review
components.reason: no examiner has reviewed this run

components.what: the report's releases: the machine's drafts and the examiner's adoptions, each signed
components.reason: no release was sealed for this run (no custody taken, or a run from before releases)
